description: Queensland public holidays under the Holidays Act 1983 (Qld), as published by the Queensland Government (statewide list; Brisbane-area basis for the show holiday).

evidence.method: Scraped from the official Queensland Government public-holidays and show-holidays pages on the checked date; public-holidays page last updated 2026-01-16, show-holidays page last updated 2026-04-09.

caveats: The Royal Queensland Show holiday (Wednesday 12 August 2026; Wednesday 11 August 2027) applies in the Brisbane area only and is included because the Supreme Court and Court of Appeal registry sits at Brisbane; every other local government district has its own appointed show holiday (97 districts in 2026), none of which is included — confirm registry-location holidays before relying on a business-day computation.
Local show holidays for districts outside Brisbane had not been published for 2027 at the checked date.
Christmas Eve is a part-day public holiday (6pm to midnight) and is not included as a non-business day.
Anzac Day is substituted only when 25 April falls on a Sunday: 2026 falls on a Saturday with no substitute; 2027 is observed on Monday 26 April as published.
